def: a co-campaigner, i.e. (figuratively) an associate in Christian toil

occurrences.text: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in thy house:
